title: The Big Farm
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 2 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ar, or, ur
note_for_grown_ups: The new teams are ar (farm), or (corn) and ur (turn). These are each two letters making one sound.

pages.text: Ned set off to the farm.
pages.illustration: Ned the gold duckling walking up a rutted farm track towards a big red barn, small against the buildings. Bright open daylight, wide sky.

pages.text: It was dark in the barn.
pages.illustration: Interior of the barn: mostly dark, one shaft of dusty light coming through a gap in the boards, straw on the floor. Ned a small silhouette in the doorway.
Two shapes half-seen in the barn gloom — a pig's round back and a hen's sharp outline — neither fully lit. Ned peering, unsure. Playful mystery.
Ned outside again in a field of tall golden corn, stalks towering over him, looking up. Warm gold filling the page.
Moss the hedgehog pushing through the corn stalks with a leaf on his back, only half visible. Ned spotting him with delight.
The two of them at a fork in the corn rows, Moss pointing firmly towards the barn roof with one paw, Ned already leaning the other way.
Ned running flat out down a long farm track that shrinks to a point in the distance. Use strong perspective to say 'far'.

pages.text: It got dark. Ned got into bed.
pages.illustration: Dusk. Ned curled up asleep in a straw-lined corner of the barn, one shaft of last light on him. Warm and safe.

pages.text: Ned had fun at the farm.
pages.illustration: Closing page: sunrise over the farm gate with Ned heading home along the track, the barn behind him. Golden and satisfied.
